name: Corvin Silt
seed: Charm, contracts and selective truth. Buys Glass Thread services through Nix; fears losing access more than losing face.
design: Male stoat, winter-cream throat, charcoal fitted coat, lilac cuffs, narrow document case.
history: Latchford inn clerk who discovered that introducing two powerful people paid better than serving them. Became Veyra’s broker eleven years ago.
desire: To be required at every important table, with enough private leverage never to be dismissed.
contradiction: Mistakes being tolerated for being trusted.
relationships: Buys jobs from Nix, bargains with Pip and flatters Veyra while hiding small side fees.
arc: Loses control when two clients compare accounts. Can confess a real crime to protect a subordinate or sacrifice them and become more isolated.
story_engine: A perfect contract depends on one deliberately misunderstood word; a public feast seats him beside someone he exploited.
writer_truth: He has no secret authority over Glass Thread; Tessera keeps evidence of his extra payments.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
